purpose: 20-strategy Binance Spot tournament based on widely used/researched bot families
execution_scope: Binance Spot long-only; no leverage; no futures; no shorts
universe_rule: Top 30 current liquid Binance Spot USDT pairs, excluding stablecoins/leveraged/wrapped/gold proxies; require >=365d 4h history and >=10M USDT rolling 30d average daily quote volume

strategies.rule: close above prior 20-bar high and ATR14/close above its 60-bar median
close below lower BB20,2 while close>EMA200
24h return<-8%, then close reclaims prior bar high while BTC regime positive
close above prior 20-bar high and volume>2x 20-bar avg
bottom-vol quartile with positive 30d momentum; select strongest momentum
top assets by 30d return / 30d realized volatility
BB width in lowest 20% of prior 120 bars then close breaks prior 20-bar high
EMA50>EMA200, close>EMA200, 30d return>0, BTC regime positive

winner_rule: No forced winner. A strategy is promotable only if every gate passes. Rank passing strategies by stress PF, then base PF, then sample size.
rule: No threshold changes after seeing Round18 results; losers are rejected, not tuned post hoc.
